purpose: L1 kernel-boundary checks on ACTUAL typed arrays captured from the observed B0 O2 topology, and candidate-vs-B0 comparison hooks for A1R..F3R (VALIDATION.md L1).

capture.method: Single bounded B0 pass (UNA(verbosity=1); RunAccessibility; RunFlow) with Python-level monkeypatching of the numba dispatcher module attributes and the one Python-method gradient boundary. wt-b0 is read-only; NO B0 source edits. njit->njit inner calls bind at compile time and are not interceptable, so the captured boundaries are exactly the Python-visible kernel boundaries a candidate must reproduce. Every _accumulate_od_flow call is ledgered; the first 2 eligible calls per origin are additionally replayed immediately with byte-identical inputs and FRESH ZERO output buffers (per-call delta form); the kernel's delivered return was bit-identical live vs zero-replay on all 32 selected calls (asserted at capture time).

ram_gate.rule: abort unless available >= max(1 GiB, 10% phys)

bounded_execution.no_sweeps: one UNA construction, one RunAccessibility, one RunFlow; nothing repeated
bounded_execution.first_attempt_note: A first capture attempt ran RunFlow with B0 flow-setting defaults (no auto gravity cap); it did not match the observed workload and was DISCARDED. The stored capture is the second (and final) run with the H04 reviewer's exact call-2 flow settings. The stale first-run export folder was deleted from campaign_data.

provenance.accessibility_settings: H04 reviewer call-1 assembly (O2.manifest settings_overrides; search_radius=500, turns=False, elevation=False, reach+exp+logistic+KNN on)

cross_check_vs_h04_reviewer.statement: The captured pass independently reproduced the H04 reviewer's observed run: all 6 exported Results files (accessibility + flow) are byte-identical (sha256) to the artifacts recorded in campaign_data/h04_observed_l2_raw.json, and the auto-resolved p95 gravity cap matches exactly (7540.0175).

sidecar.content: per-array dtype/shape/contiguity/sha256 (216 arrays), call ledgers, provenance, env, npz sha256

fixture_assets.immutability: npz + sidecar chmod 444; test_observed_fixture_files_intact re-hashes the npz file and every stored array

specialization_coverage_vs_final_workloa.statement: All final workloads are accessibility+flow with turns=False. Every compiled kernel those workloads execute is exercised by the captured pass and now has a stored observed typed-array fixture: integrated_scope_access (AccessibilityWElevation family, incl. its internal compact_vector_node_view_scope/adjust_destination_distances/reach_gravity_knn_access), _accumulate_od_flow (int32 endpoint specializations: indptr/indices/edge_id int32, dir int8), _compute_trip_volumes (literal string specializations 'exponential'/'gravity_cap'), and the scipy gradient assembly boundary. The captured dtypes pin the EXACT specializations the final workloads compile (numba specializes on dtype/contiguity; the stored arrays carry both).
specialization_coverage_vs_final_workloa.candidate_vs_b0_hook: tests/large_e2e/oracle/observed_replay.py: load a candidate namespace via b0_import.load_arm (UNA_ORACLE_ARM_A/ARM_B), run replay_integrated_scope_access / replay_od_flow / replay_trip_volumes / replay_gradient against the stored inputs, byte-compare outputs to the stored arrays with comparator.assert_array_bytes_equal (no tolerance, no exception). Exercised live in test_l1_observed.py.

negative_checks.mutation: gradient reversed-where assembly (existing F3 code-level mutant) run on the OBSERVED reverse CSR/dest_nodes/limit
negative_checks.result: CAUGHT: nodes, dist, pred all raise OracleMismatch vs the observed outputs (indptr unaffected, as designed)

negative_checks.mutation: OD budget replaced by the gradient limit (drops detour ratio/buffer — F2-class budget-computation bug)
negative_checks.result: CAUGHT at selected call seq 0 (budget 348.151 -> 525.0): out_AB and out_BA bytes move; comparator raises. Deterministic scan over selected records in seq order; smaller offsets (+1.0) verified to move no byte (budget enters the reach mask by inequality over continuous distances) and are therefore NOT used as the mutant.

limitations_and_gaps: The inner njit->njit calls (compact_vector_node_view_scope, adjust_destination_distances inside integrated_scope_access) are not separately interceptable at observed scale; at observed scale they are pinned via the outer dispatcher boundary, and their inner semantics remain pinned by the L0 corpus inner-boundary tests (base Accessibility family).

Node flow is DISABLED at O2 (out_node_flow size 0; engine node_flow absent): node-flow observables at observed scale are not capturable in this pass; node-flow semantics remain covered by the L0 traces (flow fixture with node_flow=True).
32 of 137 OD calls store full input/output arrays (deterministic first-2-per-origin rule); the other 105 are ledgered with scalars + origin identity only.

The OD fixture stores the ZERO-BUFFER per-call delta (canonical kernel-boundary form). Cumulative stripe-buffer fold association at observed scale is NOT part of this fixture (remains L0-trace/driver territory; O2 engine-level edge_flow_AB/BA outputs are stored as anchors).

Capture ran with numba's default thread count (10) as observed on this laptop; the replay tests prove byte-equality again in the suite process, and small-scale thread-count determinism is separately pinned (test_parallel_kernel_identical_across_numba_thread_counts).

Gradient replay in-suite uses chunk=512 (bounds the dense scipy transient to ~340 MB); the captured outputs were assembled at the engine's chunk rule (1754). The test proves assembled-byte chunk-invariance by matching anyway.
The fixture is a capture of ONE observed run (verified reproducible against the reviewer's independent run byte-for-byte at the export level), not an execution tile for full-scale performance claims.
